title: Emrys and the Static
author: Oscar Vasquez
blurb: Dominic Hartwell, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
